summary: Chinese papers can now be ranked and kept apart. ranking.tokenize keeps the English rule and appends character bigrams of CJK runs (split at 的/了, 21 frame-word bigrams dropped); full-width ASCII and the ideographic space fold to ASCII first. normalize_title moves to app/channels/text.py (re-exported by app.sources), keeps CJK characters and ignores spacing next to them, so distinct Chinese titles without DOI no longer collapse to one empty key. text.py also adds detect_language (script-based zh/ja/ko/en/und) and cjk_phrases. Local guidance uses whole Chinese phrases as editable keywords instead of reporting that only English works; its reply text changes accordingly. An oracle test proves English tokens and title keys are byte-identical to the previous functions for text without CJK or full-width characters.
scope_note: Class is critical only because harness/tasks.json changes (task state); the code change is standard. test_local_guidance_says_when_it_finds_no_english_terms asserted the old English-only limitation and is rewritten for the new behaviour. tools/eval_probe.py and tools/data_probe.py keep their own frozen copies for past experiments. Desktop build (.local/desktop-build-env/bin/python scripts/build_desktop.py, then cargo tauri build --bundles app) finished green; app.channels.text is in the PyInstaller archive TOC. The .app was not launched.

budget_impact.rationale: Local tokenization only; no provider, prompt, network or gateway change.
budget_impact.before: Zero model tokens; Chinese text produced no tokens.
budget_impact.after: Zero model tokens; Chinese text adds bigram tokens, CPU cost linear in text length.

checks.note: 311 of 335 passed; the 24 errors are HTTP tests whose localhost bind the agent sandbox blocks (EPERM), same as baseline. All 15 new CJK tests and the rewritten guidance test pass.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; read the diff, checked every tokenize/normalize_title caller in app/ and that the frozen tools copies are untouched.

open_risks: Ranking quality on real Chinese corpora is unmeasured; E-CJK-RANKING stays not_run until a Chinese-discipline user judges it.
Bigrams without a dictionary add noise tokens (for example 字人) that can surface as profile terms.
Splitting at 的 drops words such as 目的; phrase keywords split at 和/与/及/或 can cut words such as 和平.
Text with full-width ASCII now tokenizes where it previously gave nothing; title keys of such stored papers change only when they have no DOI or OpenAlex ID.
The HTTP tests were not run because the sandbox blocks localhost binds.
